task: Copyedit this short fictional market-news item only if there is a consequential language or fidelity problem. It is intended for a neighborhood news page. The notice supports the quotation and all practical details. Preserve the quoted contrast and return the item unchanged if no meaningful correction is needed.
input: Larch Market will close its indoor hall on Friday while electricians replace the lights, the market's notice says. Outdoor stalls will remain open. "The hall is closed; the market is not," the notice says.

facts.text: The fictional Larch Market's notice says its indoor hall will be closed on Friday.
The notice says electricians will replace the hall's lights during the closure.
The notice says outdoor stalls will remain open.
The notice includes this exact sentence: "The hall is closed; the market is not."

forbidden_additions: A whole-market closure or a claim that every stall will be closed.
A reporter's visit, named spokesperson, reopening hour, or repair cost.
New words inside the quotation that change its meaning.
preserve: The distinction between the indoor hall and outdoor stalls.
The notice's attributed quotation and its purposeful contrast.
